extracted.intended_audience: AI researchers and developers building tool-augmented language model agents and platforms
extracted.subtask_description: Designing and evaluating a collaborative platform/framework for Augmented Language Models (ALMs) that supports flexible customization, integration of models/plugins, agent composability, and thorough evaluation of agent quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flexible customization
rubrics_metrics.description: Flexible customization of agents through simple configurations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The framework should enable flexible customization of agents via simple configurations that let users tailor agents' behavior and components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seamless integration of various language models
rubrics_metrics.description: Seamlessly integrating various language models into a unified paradigm.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The platform should support interoperability between different language models so they can be plugged into agents without friction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for diverse task formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Integration of various task formats into the unified paradigm.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The framework should accommodate multiple task formats so agents can be configured for different kinds of tasks and workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prompting module modularity
rubrics_metrics.description: Integration of prompting modules as composable pieces of agent configuration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prompting modules should be supported as modular components that can be combined or swapped via configuration to change agent prompting behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plugin integration
rubrics_metrics.description: Seamless integration of plugins into agents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The system should allow plugins to be attached to agents to extend capabilities (tools, connectors) and be manageable through the same configuration paradigm.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaborative democratization (gentpool)
rubrics_metrics.description: A public platform enabling the registration and sharing of user-customized agents to advance democratization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should be able to register and share their customized agents publicly, facilitating community access and reuse.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agent composability and collaboration
rubrics_metrics.description: Agents registered in gentpool are composable such that they can be assembled together for agent collaboration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agents should be designed to be composable—i.e., assembled or orchestrated together—to enable multi-agent collaboration and richer workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Holistic evaluation (gentbench)
rubrics_metrics.description: Thoroughly evaluate user-customized agents across diverse aspects to ensure high-quality agents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An integral evaluation component should assess agents on multiple dimensions (safety, robustness, efficiency, etc.) rather than a single metric; evaluation is intended to ensure agents are high-quality before wide use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Safety as an evaluation aspect
rubrics_metrics.description: Safety should be evaluated as a core aspect of agent quality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: gentbench (or similar) must include tests/metrics that assess agent safety to prevent harmful outputs or behaviors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Robustness as an evaluation aspect
rubrics_metrics.description: Robustness should be evaluated as a core aspect of agent quality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agents should be assessed for robustness to varying inputs, adversarial prompts, or unexpected scenarios.

rubrics_metrics.name: Efficiency as an evaluation aspect
rubrics_metrics.description: Efficiency should be evaluated as a core aspect of agent quality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agent performance (e.g., latency, resource use) should be measured and factored into overall quality evaluation.
